article.excerpt: Last Thursday, Dale Mclaughlan bought a Jet Ski. On Monday, the 28-year-old Scotsman was sentenced to four weeks in jail. What happened on the three days in between, according to court documents, may be one of the more unusual instances of rule-flouting during the coronavirus pandemic. The day after purchasing the watercraft, Mr. Mclaughlan set off at 8 a.m.
